title: Wasteland Renegades: free demo
author: KingofKingsofKingsof
selftext:
I've put up a free demo of my new game.  This contains the first 2 levels that you can free run for as long as you can survive, taking down as many of your foes as you can.  I find the game very fun to play, but do others?  Any feedback would be appreciated.  I have the full game more or less ready, but am trying to ascertain the market and whether a Steam release is worth it.  (It plays wonderfully on Steam Deck).  
[Wasteland Renegades: Warriors of the Road (Demo) by stuartking84](https://stuartking84.itch.io/wasteland-renegades)

  
Created with Claude, ChatGPT for graphics. This is version 0.9.92, so god knows how many commits that it.
